density: one subtle easter egg maximum per strip
rules: Reward repeat readers without making the detail required for the joke.
Keep each detail small, visual, and quiet.
Avoid readable generated text unless it is added deterministically after art generation.
Do not repeat the same hidden joke too often.
Never place an easter egg where it competes with speech balloons, title, logo, or acting.
